Auto is crimson, and the music and your face shift it. Tap a colour to pick your own.

Show opening

Minutes until you start. The card covers your camera, then burns away to your real face at zero. Taps and gifts charge the meter; they never change the time.

Your real face burns into the Mask, on the next beat. Press again to come back.

Your signs

A video (mp4, webm) or a picture (png, gif, jpg) on a pure green background, up to 60 MB. It is kept on this PC only and loops without sound.

Preview: is the green gone?

Green still showing: turn it up. Parts of your sign missing: turn it down.

Puppet show

The Mask eats the song's cover when you press DONE or ADD TO AI RADIO on your site, chews on the beat, and spits your verdict as a word. EAT IT makes it eat now. This works with the Puppet show off.

Moves

Votes

A new vote by itself about every 4 minutes. Never during a boss fight.

A viewer who types goo, fire, melt, crack or eat sets off that move: one every 12 seconds for the whole room, one a minute for each viewer. A gift sets off a bigger move.

Hold a hand up by your face: right hand = angel, left = devil.

If the angel shows on your left hand, turn this on.

A viewer who sends a gift circles the Mask with their picture for a while. A bigger gift stays longer.

Where the fight's bars sit

Top is where your hype bar sits. Slide to put them anywhere between; the Mask moves out of their way.
